sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: The food supermarkets throw away
passage.text: A supermarket throws away food for reasons that have little to do with hunger and everything to do with appearance. A banana with a brown spot, a loaf past its display date, a carton dented in delivery: all are edible, none is sellable by the usual rules. Some chains now sell such items at a discount in a separate aisle, and a few have changed the rules themselves, removing best-before dates from fruit and vegetables. The results are modest but consistent: less waste, lower costs, and customers who say they prefer shops that do it. The obstacle is not customer resistance but the habit of ordering by appearance.

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: supermarkets waste large amounts of edible food. Discuss the causes and suggest what shops and customers can do.

answer.text: Supermarkets discard edible food for reasons that are commercial rather than biological. A spotted banana or a dented carton breaks the rules of display, and ordering systems reward full shelves over empty ones. The waste is therefore built into habits, not into customer preference. Shops can change the habits: sell imperfect produce in a designated aisle, drop best-before dates where they carry no safety meaning, and order by observed demand rather than by appearance. Customers can help by buying the discounted items and by treating a brown spot as a sign of ripeness rather than a defect. Neither change is dramatic, but together they keep good food in kitchens instead of bins.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只强调「顾客应该买丑蔬果」，忽略订货与陈列规则这一主要成因。
